column13: Robbery A male watches older lady enter lift in Derbion. He then enters the lift after her followed by another male who approaches from a different direction. The first male then forceably takes the handbag off the lady and attempts to run out of the lift with it. The second male pulls the first male back resulting in him dropping the handbag. Both males then leave the area together and run off towards the bus station.
